scope: Thirty original remaining testimony/statement URLs, ten each on three hosts that returned usable PDFs in the bounded probe.
guardrails: Reuse an already validated final URL before downloading it
Skip deferred URLs and body digests
Do not retain video/audio response bytes
Stop a host after refusal or three consecutive transport failures
Preserve redirects and every response receipt
completion_requirements: Actual wait exit and process absence
Full payload hashes and structural checks
Keep PDFs with warnings pending separate qualification
